description: Well Delivery System Database for Oil & Gas Operations

tables.table_description: Master table for all wells. Contains well records with rig assignments, status, location, and lift type information. This is the central entity for well delivery tracking.
tables.total_rows: Unknown (sample shows 100 rows with Well_IDs from 27129 to 37797)

columns.description: Sequential serial number for the well record (1, 2, 3, etc.)
Drilling rig number assigned to the well (101, 102, 103, 104, 137, 149, 81, 82, etc.)
Unique 5-digit well identifier. Primary key for this table.
Latest Rig on Location date - when the rig arrived at the well site. Format: DD-MMM-YY (e.g., 14-Jul-25)
Latest Rig Off date - when the rig leaves the well site. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
Category of well. Values: SCR/EMOC (Scoping Complete), New Well - KPI, Non KPI Well, NULL, etc.
Location station code. Values: NIM (Nimr), SSFD (South), SSFDP, MALRTQ (Marmul), etc.
Oil field name where well is located. Values: NIMR E, NIMR A, AL BURJ, RAKID SOUTH, AMIN, etc.
Full descriptive location name of the well.
Artificial lift type. Values: PI (Progressive Injection), ESP (Electrical Submersible Pump), PCP (Progressive Cavity Pump), BP (Beam Pump), WI (Water Injector), OP (Oil Producer), WSW, DWI

common_queries: SELECT * FROM [2026_Well_Delivery_Scope_Well_Type] WHERE Well_ID = 31477
SELECT Well_ID, Well_Category, Field, Lift_type FROM [2026_Well_Delivery_Scope_Well_Type] WHERE Field = 'NIMR E'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [2026_Well_Delivery_Scope_Well_Type] WHERE Well_Category = 'SCR/EMOC'

tables.table_description: Detailed task breakdown for every well with 38 columns and millions of rows. Tracks all activities from start to finish with WBS hierarchy, progress, manhours, and dates. Most important operational table.
tables.total_rows: Unknown (sample shows 100 rows with row_id from 1 to 100)

columns.description: Unique primary key identifier for each task
External source system identifier for the task. Usually NULL.
Additional task data stored as text. Often empty string.
Hierarchical path showing parent relationships. Format: comma-separated IDs (e.g., '143508,143804')
Planned duration of the task in days. Usually '1.0' for most tasks.
Current completion percentage. Values: 0.0 (Not Started), 0.85, 1.0 (Complete), etc.
Unique identifier of assigned crew. Often empty string.
Type of crew needed for the task.
Planned manhours required for the task.
Weight/importance of task in overall project progress.
Parent task row_id for hierarchical structure. Format: '143508.0'
Scheduled start date of the task. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
Scheduled end date of the task. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
Original target start date from plan
Original target end date from plan
Actual date when work started. '1900-01-01' indicates not started.
Actual date when work was completed. '1900-01-01' indicates not completed.
Actual manhours spent on the task
Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code. Format: PW1.3, PW1.3.5.6, etc.
Task type. Values: W = Work, M = Milestone
Days remaining to complete the task
Associated well identifier (foreign key to Well master)

common_queries: SELECT code, text, progress, start_date, end_date, manhoursactual FROM ActivityTaskPlan WHERE Well_ID = '33151' ORDER BY row_id
SELECT code, text, progress, parent, ancestor FROM ActivityTaskPlan WHERE Well_ID = '33151' AND type = 'W'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ActivityTaskPlan WHERE Well_ID = '33151'

tables.table_description: Well Monitoring Report. Comprehensive progress tracking dashboard with 128 columns covering location preparation, engineering, construction, and commissioning metrics.

columns.description: Serial number in the report. Usually '1.0'
Drilling rig number. Values: SWERIG81, SWER103, SWER101, SWER137, SWER102, etc.
Type of well. Values: PCP, ESP, BP, WI, NULL
Previous week's expected rig on location date
Latest expected rig on location date

common_queries: SELECT pdo_well_id, over_all_progress_percentages, actual_start_date, actual_rig_on_date FROM WMR WHERE pdo_well_id = '33151'
SELECT rig_no, well_location, over_all_progress_percentages FROM WMR WHERE over_all_progress_percentages > '0.5'
SELECT rig_no, COUNT(*) FROM WMR GROUP BY rig_no

tables.table_description: Employee master data. Contains personal information, status, supervisor hierarchy, and company assignments.
tables.total_rows: Unknown (sample shows 100 rows with id from 4809 to 4908)

columns.description: Unique external identifier for the employee

common_queries: SELECT id, Name, Email, Status FROM Employee WHERE Name LIKE '%KAMAL%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE Status = 'Active'
SELECT * FROM Employee WHERE EmployeeType = 1855

tables.table_description: Crew master data. Defines crew codes, types, supervisors, and employee/equipment assignments.
tables.total_rows: Unknown (sample shows 100 rows with ID from 4685 to 9945)

columns.description: Crew code. Format: LOCATION_TYPE_NUMBER (e.g., HIT_CSE0302_4, MES_CGD0602_09)
List of employee IDs in the crew. Format: [123, 456, 789]
List of equipment IDs in the crew. Usually empty []

common_queries: SELECT Code, Supervisor, Employees FROM crews WHERE Code LIKE 'NIM%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crews WHERE Supervisor IS NOT NULL
SELECT * FROM crews WHERE CrewType = '299'

tables.table_description: Many-to-many mapping between crews and employees. Links employees to their assigned crews.
tables.total_rows: Unknown (sample shows 100 rows with id from 2110 to 2209)

columns.description: Crew ID (foreign key to crews table)
Employee ID (foreign key to Employee table)

common_queries: SELECT e.Name, ce.Crew FROM Employee e JOIN CrewEmployee ce ON e.id = ce.Employee WHERE ce.Crew = 320
SELECT Crew, COUNT(*) FROM CrewEmployee GROUP BY Crew
SELECT * FROM CrewEmployee WHERE Employee = 8311

tables.table_description: Equipment inventory. Tracks vehicles, heavy equipment, tools with status, location, and type information.
tables.total_rows: Unknown (sample shows 100 rows with ID from 1086 to 1185)

columns.description: Equipment status. Values: Eqp Surplus Maintenance, Eqp is Surplus, Eqp In Operation
Equipment type identifier (foreign key to EquipmentType table)

common_queries: SELECT LicensePlate, Description, Status, EquipmentType FROM Equipment WHERE Location = 55
SELECT Status, COUNT(*) FROM Equipment GROUP BY Status
SELECT * FROM Equipment WHERE EquipmentType = 332

tables.table_description: Daily task execution records. Captures actual daily work, quantities, hours, and completions for tasks.
tables.total_rows: Unknown (sample shows 100 rows with id from 1416 to 1515)

columns.description: Date of the daily task action. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
Duration of the task in days
Task ready flag. 1 = Ready, 0 = Not Ready
Task completed flag. 1 = Completed, 0 = Not Completed

common_queries: SELECT * FROM task_daily WHERE well_id = '34398' AND ActionOn >= '2024-12-01'
SELECT task_code, SUM(required) FROM task_daily WHERE well_id = '34398' GROUP BY task_code
SELECT ActionOn, COUNT(*) FROM task_daily WHERE completed = 1 GROUP BY ActionOn

tables.table_description: Revenue and progress value tracking. Links progress to financial metrics and purpose values.
tables.total_rows: Unknown (sample shows 100 rows with id from 16 to 115)

columns.description: Step type. Values: LOC, ENG, etc.

example_values: Surveying & Setting out for Well Pad
Cutting, Removal and Levelling of Jebel (Rock)

common_queries: SELECT * FROM Revenue WHERE well_id = '33151' ORDER BY id
SELECT code, Title, total_purpose_value FROM Revenue WHERE step_type = 'LOC'
SELECT SUM(total_purpose_value) FROM Revenue WHERE well_id = '33151'

tables.table_description: SAP drilling sequence and rig move planning. Contains SAP drilling schedules, well locations, and rig assignments.

columns.description: Work center / rig identifier. Values: SWER149, SWERIG99, SWER101, etc.
Short operation code. Format: Y762-10207, Y760-10239, 6845-10995
Station code. Values: SSFDP, LEK, USP, NIM, etc.
Responsible asset. Values: SOUTH, NORTH, GAS
Well function. Values: Oil Producer, Water Injector, Gas Producer
PCAP category. Values: Category IV, Category III
Move days for rig. Usually 0 or 1

common_queries: SELECT * FROM SAP_DRILLING_SEQUENCE WHERE Well_ID = '10207'
SELECT Work_Center, Well_Name, Earl_start_date, EarliestEndDate FROM SAP_DRILLING_SEQUENCE WHERE Responsible_asset = 'SOUTH' ORDER BY Earl_start_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SAP_DRILLING_SEQUENCE WHERE Well_Function = 'Oil Producer'
